verdict.rationale: Missive documents a client-side Custom MCP feature: you add any MCP-compatible server by name and URL, choose an authentication method (none, bearer token, or OAuth 2.0 with custom scopes), and its AI assistant can then use that server's tools. It also ships built-in MCP integrations for Notion, Linear, Attio and Lindy.ai, running on your own Anthropic, OpenAI or Gemini key. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that custom MCP servers work in practice.
